status: Approved design for full authoring; not chapter acceptance

proof_judgments.design: Two-of-four inclusion covariances yield stratum baseline sample variance; independent strata and squared weights yield both design variances. Constant stratum effects justify unbiased Neyman variance estimation here.
proof_judgments.finite_p: Tie groups and their cumulative masses prove inclusive finite p validity; complement pairing sets minimum 1/18. Sharp-zero and weak-average nulls remain distinct.
proof_judgments.direction_search: Symmetry makes the direction-selected tail statistic a monotone function of absolute contrast; replay restores its finite null calibration, with the zero tie explicitly handled.
proof_judgments.transport: Uniform conceptual I independent of whole Z yields one-person probabilities without iid assignment claims. Conditional mean equality and support are substantive assumptions. Fixed and ratio denominators coincide because balanced counts make both treatment weight sums deterministic.
proof_judgments.transport_bounds: Positive linear weights yield rectangular extrema, with endpoint/mixture witnesses; common level shifts preserve effects. Unsupported-cell target is a separate law.
proof_judgments.restricted_input: Finite-cent completions form a lattice, not every real point of its envelope. Absolute affine inequalities establish all real breakpoints and inclusive boundaries before grid enumeration. Earlier oracle/results are excluded from the alternative auditor information set.

exercise_judgment: All twelve are determinate or have explicit open-response criteria; counterfactual target, selection, unsupported-cell and withheld-input variants provide transfer. Full teaching and complete solutions remain author deliverables.
limits: Source preparation already fully reviewed; no new primary-body reading claimed here. All data synthetic. Design approval is not written content, accepted review, empirical replication or rendered-reader QA.
